set firewall family inet filter NETOPS-G142-IN term t-deny from source-address 198.51.100.0/24
set firewall family inet filter NETOPS-G142-IN term t-deny then discard
set firewall family inet filter NETOPS-G142-IN term t-src from source-address 192.0.2.0/24
set firewall family inet filter NETOPS-G142-IN term t-src then count c-src
set firewall family inet filter NETOPS-G142-IN term t-src then accept
set firewall family inet filter NETOPS-G142-IN term t-rest then count c-rest
set firewall family inet filter NETOPS-G142-IN term t-rest then accept
